# Account and Data Deletion

You can request deletion of your Lody account and associated data from this page.
You do not need to have the app installed to make this request.

## How to Request Deletion

Email us at [contact@lody.ai](mailto:contact@lody.ai?subject=Request%20account%20and%20data%20deletion)
with the subject "Request account and data deletion".

Please include enough information for us to identify and verify the account, such as:

- The email address used to sign in to Lody
- Your GitHub username, Google account email, Apple account email, or Discord username if used for sign-in
- Any workspace name or workspace URL you want us to check

We may reply to confirm ownership before deleting data.

## What Will Be Deleted

After the request is verified, we will delete or permanently de-identify account data associated
with your Lody account, including:

- Account and authentication records
- Workspace membership records
- Workspace, session, conversation, and workflow data associated with your account where deletion is allowed
- CLI tokens and connected integration records associated with your account

## What May Be Retained

Some limited records may be retained when required for legal, security, fraud-prevention, abuse
prevention, accounting, or operational integrity reasons. Retained records are limited to what is
necessary for those purposes.

## Timeline

After a deletion request is received and confirmed, associated data is permanently cleared within
30 days, except for records that must be retained for the reasons listed above.
